messages:
deploy-bot: PROD rollout starting for service `inference-runtime` in prod-usw2. Commit: `0f3a2b7` (tag: release/v3.6.1). Release lead: @jordan. Change window: 2026-03-19 22:00 UTC. Traffic plan: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 10m observation per step. Rollback criteria: >2% 5xx or p95 latency >200ms. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prod-rollout-inference

jordan: Ack. I'll coordinate checks and open the incident channel if needed. @priya please watch SRE dashboards, @sam infra on standby.

priya: Watching dashboards now, alert rules loaded, will post gaps.

sam: Infra: canary node pool patched (kernel + nv driver). GPU pool reserve set to 4xA100, containers sized `cpu: 4`, `gpu: 1`.

maya: Notifying enterprise customers about minor upgrade and expected short period of degraded perf during canary.

jordan: Starting canary traffic shift now.

deploy-bot: Canary shift to 5% initiated -> complete. Commit `0f3a2b7` pinned for canary. Smoke tests: passed. Health checks: ok.

prometheus-bot: Alert: inference-runtime/canary 5xx error rate increased: 0.8% -> 3.2% (2m avg) :warning:

priya: Seeing the same. Holding traffic. Canaries show some OOMs on model load. @sam can you tail logs on host canary-02?

sam: Tailing logs now. Getting repeated "OOM when allocating kv-cache" on canary-02. Restarting runtime on that host.

sam: Restart done. Pods rescheduled.

priya: After restart error rate dropping to 0.6%. Recommending hold for 5m, then progress to 10% if stable.

jordan: Agreed. Hold and monitor. Thanks @sam.

priya: 5m monitor complete, error rate stable, p95 150ms, no 5xx spikes. Resume to 10% now.

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 10% -> complete. Observability: p95 150ms, 5xx 0.6%, cpu/gpu within expected.

jordan: Proceeding with 25% after additional observation window (10m).

(deploy after 10m)

deploy-bot: Traffic shifted to 25% -> complete. Observability: p95 160ms, 5xx 0.4%.

priya: All checks green. No regressions in SLOs.

jordan: Rolling to 100% now.

deploy-bot: Final rollout to 100% initiated.

deploy-bot: PROD rollout complete ✅. Service `inference-runtime` at 100% on tag `release/v3.6.1` (commit `0f3a2b7`). Total duration ~18m. No rollback required. Runbook notes: prefixed OOM during canary resolved by restart; infra to investigate model load memory thresholds.

jordan: Great job everyone :shipit: — keeping postmortem light: infra to adjust kube mem limits, priya to add temporary alerting tweak.

maya: I'll update release notes and customer comms: "v3.6.1 deployed to prod - improved throughput, minor memory tuning follow-up."

sam: Logging follow-up ticket: INF-4821 — investigate OOM root cause and increase model load grace period.

priya: Closing monitoring loop. No SLO breaches.

deploy-bot: Pinning tag `release/v3.6.1` to prod cluster. If you need to rollback, run: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-runtime --to-revision=3`

jordan: Closing thread. Thanks all.
